G201463.description: Rwamagana is a city and capital of both the Rwamagana District and the Eastern Province in Rwanda

G201521.description: Ruhengeri, today known as Musanze is the third largest city in Rwanda and the capital of Musanze District in the Northern Province of Rwanda. The city has a population of 153,368 as of the 2022 census.

G201524.description: Ruhango is a sector and town in Southern Province, Rwanda. The town is the capital of the Ruhango District.

G201650.description: Nyagatare is a town in the North East of Rwanda. With a population of more than 100,000, it is one of the most populous settlements in the Eastern Province along with Rwamagana and Kibungo.

G202039.description: town in Kinigi Sector, Musanze District, Northern Province, Rwanda

G202061.description: Kigali (Kinyarwanda pronunciation: [ki.ɡɑ́.ɾi]), officially the City of Kigali also known as Kigali City (abbreviated as KGL or CoK), is the capital, largest city, and a province-level administrative unit of Rwanda. It is located near the country's geographic centre, in a landscape of rolling hills marked by valleys and ridges connected by steep slopes.

G202065.description: Kibuye() is a city in Karongi District, and the headquarters of the Western Province in Rwanda.

G202068.description: Kibungo is a town and sector in the Republic of Rwanda. It is the political, administrative and commercial capital of Ngoma District.

G202217.description: Muhanga (former Gitarama, renamed in 2006) is a city in Rwanda, in the Muhanga District, in Southern Province. The city is situated 5,945 feet (1,812 m) above sea level.

G202300.description: Gahini is a sector and village in Kayonza District, Eastern Province, Rwanda. It is situated on a hill, at an altitude of 1,520 metres (4,990 ft) above sea-level, close to the eastern edge of Lake Muhazi and 73 kilometres (45 mi) by road from the capital, Kigali.

G202326.description: Cyangugu (formerly Shangugu) is a city and capital of the Rusizi District in Western Province, Rwanda. The city lies at the southern end of Lake Kivu, and is contiguous with Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, but separated from it by the Ruzizi River.

G202345.description: Shyorongi is a town and sector in the Rulindo district of Northern Province, Rwanda.

G202557.description: Ngororero is a sector and town in Rwanda.

G202572.description: Ndera is one of the 15 sectors that make up the district of Gasabo found in kigali city. It is about 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the capital.

G202905.description: Gisenyi, historically rendered as Kisenyi, is the second largest city in Rwanda, located in the Rubavu district in Rwanda's Western Province.

G203104.description: Byumba is a city and sector in northern Rwanda and the capital of Gicumbi District. It is home to an SOS Children's Village.

G203119.description: Busogo is a town and sector of Musanze district, Northern Province, Rwanda.

G384311.description: Mukamira () is a town and sector in Western Province, Rwanda. The town is the capital of Nyabihu District.

G384535.description: Kayonza is a small town in Kayonza district, Eastern Province, Rwanda. The town is centred on a roundabout, where the road east from Kigali splits into the road running north to the Ugandan border, and the road south to Tanzania.

G7062967.description: Nyanza, also known as Nyabisindu, is a town located in Nyanza District in the Southern Province of Rwanda. Nyanza is the capital of the Southern Province.

G7656357.description: Nyamata is a town and sector in the Bugesera District, southeastern Rwanda. Nyamata literally means 'place of milk' from the two Kinyarwanda words nya- 'of' and amata 'milk'.
